title: Aureline M5 scaffold-handoff-banner component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the scaffold-handoff-banner family binds inside the frozen M5 scaffold-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-scaffold-component-matrix.schema.json). A scaffold handoff banner names the bootstrap outcome and the recovery path it keeps explicit so a partial or failed bootstrap is never presented as a clean create and delete-generated or continue-without-starter recovery is never hidden. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-templates is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
